section.para: Since this activity was designed to be completed without technology, ask students to put away any devices.
section.title: Student Activity
section.para: Here are graphs that represent three quadratic functions, defined by:

image.alt: Coordinate plane with 3 quadratic functions. Curve A opens up and has minimum at 0 comma 4. Curve B opens up and has minimum at negative 4 comma 0. Curve C opens down and has maximum 0 comma 1.

list.item: Which part of the equation tells us that Graph C opens downward?

section.para: Answer: \(y=1-x^2\) is the equation. The negative coefficient of \(x^2\) makes the graph open downward.
section.title: Response to Student Thinking
Press Pause
section.para: If students are still struggling with finding \(x\)- and \(y\)-intercepts of the graph, consider skipping lesson 7.13 and, instead, addressing misconceptions in the cool downs and working on practice problems.
